text:
alejandra: Heads up — I pushed terraform for the new GPU autoscale policy and premerge is failing OPA checks.

tom: link to the pipeline? I want to see the exact policy failure.

alejandra: https://ci.internal/redwood/3321 -> `conftest test` output shows `deny[reason]` on `module.gpu_pool` claiming `allowed_locations` doesn't match org-level whitelist.

ci-bot: CI failed: conftest (OPA) policy: infra/location_whitelist.rego -> 1 deny(s)

alejandra: The cluster needs us in europe-west3 for residency reasons. The org whitelist only has us-west2 + us-east1. We need an exemption for this change or to add europe-west3 to the whitelist.

ryan: Why is europe-west3 not on the whitelist? I thought we onboarded it last quarter for retail customers.

jamie: We did enable the region for hosted earlier but the infra policy table that Conftest reads is still managed centrally. That repo is locked behind the freeze window until Mon 09:00 UTC.

alejandra: Right — the change to the whitelist would be a cross-repo edit and would violate the current freeze window. I can either request an emergency exemption or rework the TF to use a supported fallback region + explicit routing.

infra-oncall: @alejandra can you paste the failing snippet? Also include the plan so we can assess blast radius.

alejandra: snippet:
```
module "gpu_pool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@internal:redwood/infra/terraform//gpu-pools?ref=pr-3321"
  region = "europe-west3"
  size = 12
}
```
Conftest error:
```
infra/location_whitelist.rego: deny["region_not_allowed"] {
  input.resource.region == "europe-west3"
  not allowed_region[input.resource.region]
}
```

ops-bot: Freeze window in effect: 2026-03-15T22:00Z -> 2026-03-22T09:00Z. Emergency exemptions require 2x infra-sig approvals + SRE oncall ack.

tom: @ryan @jamie if we can't change the whitelist during freeze, can we change the TF to `region = var.allowed_region` and map europe-west3 via an app-layer routing rule so traffic is pinned? That feels hacky.

ryan: Hacky yes, but less risky than breaking the freeze. How urgent is the residency requirement? Can it wait until the freeze lifts in 3 days?

alejandra: Customer legal signoff needs european residency by EOD tomorrow. Can't wait.

jamie: Ok — follow emergency exemption flow. Alejandra, open an exemption PR in infra-policy-exceptions repo with: 1) justification, 2) risk assessment, 3) rollback plan, 4) SRE oncall sig. Tag me and Ryan.

alejandra: Created PR #78 in infra-policy-exceptions and added the required form. Requesting approvals: @jamie @ryan @infra-oncall

ryan: Reviewing now. Initial comment: please include monitoring thresholds and an autoscale ceiling to reduce cost risk. Also add a conftest whitelist override scoped to the specific module/path so it's narrow.

alejandra: Added autoscale ceiling (`max_size = 12`) and a scoped override in PR description. Also included terraform plan output.

ci-bot: Danger check: terraform plan drift detection -> no drift for prod clusters.

ops-bot: SRE oncall ACK received from infra-oncall at 1795001500. Jamie's approval pending.

jamie: Approved after confirming scoped override and SAFETY: canary deploy to a single cluster then verify network egress and KMS bindings. :white_check_mark:

alejandra: Thanks — merging exception PR now.

ci-bot: Conftest re-run on PR-3321 -> PASS (1 overridden policy: infra/location_whitelist.rego: scoped exemption applied)

alejandra: Pushing terraform apply to staging first, will monitor token-level cost and network flows.

ryan: Make sure to tag cost center and include budget alert. If we see >20% deviation in GPU spend we'll scale down manually.

alejandra: Will do. Monitoring dash link: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/gpu-pool-ops

ops-bot: Note for audit logs: exception PR #78 linked to change 3321, created_by=alejandra, approved_by=[jamie, infra-oncall], expiration=2026-04-05T09:00Z

alejandra: Rolling apply in 2m. Posting updates.

infra-oncall: Observability looks clean after canary. No egress anomalies, KMS access logs normal.

alejandra: Apply finished. Staging cluster healthy. Opening change for prod canary scheduled in 30m.

ryan: Great work getting the exception through so quickly. Postmortem/notes for eventual whitelist update when freeze ends.

jamie: We'll add the region to the official whitelist next maintenance window and remove the scoped exemption. Logged task in infra board: INFRA-1427.

alejandra: Closing thread, will file follow-up doc with timeline and cost delta.

ops-bot: Thread closed by alejandro at 1795001723.
